title: Horror
story: Spooky movie night, where every scare ends in a giggle.

cards.name: Jack-o'-Lantern
cards.subject: A round orange pumpkin with vertical ribs, a short green stem on top and a carved face of two triangle eyes and a jagged smile glowing yellow from inside, sitting on wooden porch planks.
cards.hero_colors: orange pumpkin, green stem, yellow glowing face

cards.name: Witch Hat
cards.subject: A black witch hat with a tall pointed cone that bends slightly at the tip, a wide round flat brim and a purple band around the base of the cone.
cards.hero_colors: black felt, purple band

cards.name: Cauldron
cards.subject: A round black iron cauldron with a wide rim and two side handles, standing on three short legs, filled with bubbling green potion and big bubbles, over a bright fire with a yellow-white glowing core, orange flame tips curling upward, glowing orange ends on the logs, and warm orange light cast on what stands near it.
cards.hero_colors: black iron, bright green potion, orange fire
cards.surface_or_setting: stone floor of a fireplace hearth

cards.name: Ghost Sheet
cards.subject: A floating white sheet shaped like a friendly ghost, with a rounded top, two round black eye holes, arms-like folds at the sides and a wavy hem trimmed with a thin pale blue edge.
cards.hero_colors: white sheet, pale blue trim

cards.name: Bat
cards.subject: A flying bat seen from the front with wings fully spread, each wing with scalloped edges and finger-like ribs, a small round body, two pointed ears and tiny feet.
cards.hero_colors: dark purple-brown bat, pink inner ears

cards.name: Crystal Ball
cards.subject: A perfectly round clear glass ball filled with swirling violet mist, resting in a gold stand with a round base and a red band around the base.
cards.hero_colors: clear glass, violet mist, gold stand, red band

cards.name: Haunted Door
cards.subject: A closed arched wooden door made of vertical planks with two black iron hinge straps, a round iron ring knocker in the middle and a small round peephole glowing yellow, set in a gray stone wall.
cards.hero_colors: brown wood, black iron, yellow glowing peephole
cards.surface_or_setting: gray stone wall of an old house front with a stone doorstep

cards.name: Spooky Tree
cards.subject: A bare tree with a thick twisted trunk and long gnarled branches that curve upward, a few orange autumn leaves clinging to the twigs, roots spreading into the grass.
cards.hero_colors: dark brown trunk, orange leaves

cards.name: Potion
cards.subject: A round glass flask with a narrow neck and a light brown cork stopper, filled with glowing green liquid with small bubbles, and a small label showing a yellow star icon, standing on wooden planks.
cards.hero_colors: green glass liquid, light brown cork, yellow star icon

cards.name: Boo Surprise
cards.subject: The pig stands on two legs wearing a white ghost sheet with two eye holes and jumps out with raised arms in front of the man, who calmly sips from a tea cup with his mustache twitching.
cards.hero_colors: pink pig under white sheet, brown-haired man with brown mustache and round glasses
cards.surface_or_setting: wooden porch beside an old door with a pumpkin

cards.name: Broomstick

cards.name: Black Cat

cards.name: Spell Book

cards.name: Castle Tower

cards.name: Candlestick
